footers.sam: RenewaBlox Investor Atlas · Year-5 Total Contract Values modelled from the Scrivelsby peaker and 1,000 kW stranded-hydro client cases, scaled across the portfolio. Sources: RenewaBlox_AD_BM_CRM & RenewaBlox_Hydro_Stranded (16 Jun 2026). Indicative; not investment advice.
footers.tam: RenewaBlox Investor Atlas · TAM — every subsidised biogas, biomass, EfW, landfill and sewage-gas CHP holding an RO or FiT accreditation. Sources: DNO Embedded Capacity Registers (NGED, NPG, SPEN, SSEN Jul 2026, UKPN) + Ofgem FiT, RO and REGO registers (Aug 2026). Co-located records are collapsed to one marker per site with capacity capped at the DNO connection figure (194 MW of double-counting removed across 87 sites); 8 transmission-connected thermal stations >100 MW are excluded. 220 sites are plotted at postcode-district centroid (dashed). BM tier is indicative, modelled from the 129 verified SAM sites; Scotland sits outside the modelled tiers.
footers.ppa: RenewaBlox Investor Atlas · PPA & Price Benchmark — Elexon BMRS Market Index (APXMIDP) settlement data, Montel/EEX forward curve snapshot 11 Aug 2026, Ofgem Feed-in Tariff and REGO registers. Contracted PPA prices are private bilateral terms and are not shown anywhere; the counterparty is inferred from REGO certificate holdings.

notes.sam: TCV is modelled per kW available for BM; 24 sites (hollow) await a figure. In the legend, the + figures compare each tier’s average BM revenue with the 8.0p wholesale baseline. Card offtaker is inferred from the largest external REGO certificate holder — strong evidence of who buys the power, not contractual proof. Full detail on the PPA Benchmark tab.
notes.tam: Markers are unfilled: ring colour = technology, shape = subsidy (triangle = RO, circle = FiT), size = capacity, dashed = approximate location. BM tier is indicative, modelled from the verified SAM sites. TCV Potential applies the priced SAM sites’ own Year-5 TCV per kW-available (by tier) to each site’s available-for-BM capacity — the DNO maximum export capacity where the register gives one (727 sites), otherwise installed capacity at the SAM fleet’s ratio. Scotland sits outside the modelled tiers, so it carries no BM revenue and is excluded from TCV Potential.
notes.hydro: Stranded generation runs Bitcoin mining 24/7 — no grid export and no BM revenue, so TCV = mined BTC value.

drawer.title: Sources & method
sources: DNO Embedded Capacity Registers (NGED, NPG, SPEN, SSEN Jul 2026, UKPN)
drawer.provenance: Provenance. Realised prices — Elexon BMRS Market Index Data, APXMIDP feed, 70,085 half-hourly settlement records Aug 2024–Jul 2026 (the N2EX feed reports zero volume and is excluded). Forward curve — Montel, EEX UK power futures, previous-settlement column, snapshot 11 Aug 2026. Export arrangement and FiT tariffs — Ofgem Feed-in Tariff Installation Report, March 2026; 128 of 129 sites matched on outcode, capacity, commissioning date and local authority. Counterparty — Ofgem Renewable Energy Register, REGO Accredited Stations and REGO Certificates (159 MB, 777,188 rows), current-holder field for the most recent output period. Not shown, because it does not exist publicly: contracted PPA prices for the 108 negotiated sites. Sourcing a discount-to-baseload benchmark is the remaining gap. Forward curve and counterparty data are point-in-time snapshots and need re-pulling to stay current.
glossary: BM
The Balancing Mechanism: National Grid ESO's real-time market for flexing generation up or down to keep the system balanced.
BM tier
Five location tiers grading how often and how richly a connection point is called in the Balancing Mechanism. Tier 1 is highest.
SAM
Serviceable market: the 129 verified anaerobic-digestion sites RenewaBlox can serve today.
TAM
Total addressable market: every subsidised biogas, biomass, energy-from-waste, landfill and sewage-gas generator with RO or FiT accreditation.
REGO
Renewable Energy Guarantees of Origin: certificates issued per MWh of renewable output; the holder is usually the buyer of the power.
FiT
Feed-in Tariff: the statutory scheme paying a generation tariff plus a guaranteed export rate.
RO
Renewables Obligation: the certificate-based subsidy scheme for larger generators.
MEC / export capacity
The maximum export capacity the network operator allows a site to send to the grid.
Stranded
Output a site can generate but cannot export, because installed capacity exceeds its export capacity.
MPAN
Meter Point Administration Number: one per metered supply point; some sites aggregate several.
Offer event
A Balancing Mechanism instruction accepting a generator's offer to increase output.
TCV
Total Contract Value: the modelled value of a site's contract at Year 5 — BM and energy revenue plus the value of Bitcoin mined with otherwise unused capacity.
Treasury
The TCV variant in which mined Bitcoin is held in treasury and revalued, rather than sold as it is mined.
Year 5
The fifth contract year, the basis of every TCV figure in this atlas.

about.title: About this map
body: The RenewaBlox Investor Atlas sets out the modelled Year-5 contract value of the RenewaBlox pipeline: {{sam_n}} AD peakers in the Balancing Mechanism ({{inv_priced}} priced), {{hydro_n}} stranded hydro units mining Bitcoin, and an indicative TCV Potential across {{tam_n}} subsidised generators.
The PPA Benchmark sets realised and forward GB power prices against the guaranteed FiT export tariff for every serviceable site.
Contract values are modelled from the Scrivelsby peaker and 1,000 kW stranded-hydro client cases and scaled across the portfolio. Indicative; not investment advice. Confidential — investor use only.
